VICE Logo ID | Laurent Malys
blocks.description:
For this VICE Logo ID, [@laurent.malys](https://www.instagram.com/laurent.malys/) utilized mathematics and code to create and animate abstract graphic systems. Drawing inspiration from the trajectories of players’ movements on the field, Laurent choreographs the athletes, leading to the formation of the VICE logo.

Artist: Laurent Malys [@laurent.malys](https://www.instagram.com/laurent.malys/)
CD: Julie Ruiz [@julieblueruiz](https://www.instagram.com/julieblueruiz/)

blocks.title: Type me, Type me not Interactive typography, 1998
blocks.description: These experiments in computational typography were based on my coursework from a class John Maeda taught at the MIT Media Laboratory in the fall of 1997. Type me, Type me not received a gold award from the 1998 ID Magazine Interactive Media Design Review. The original project was a Java Applet, and I ported it to P5.js in 2016.
